roles.name: Intent Analyzer
roles.description: Identify the user's intent and required operations.

roles.name: Function Matcher
roles.description: Select the appropriate functions and map arguments.

roles.name: Tool-Call Validator
roles.description: Check function names, arguments, and call order.

roles.name: Function-Call Refiner
roles.description: Resolve omissions and inconsistencies in the proposed calls.

roles.name: Final Function-Call Generator
roles.description: Return the required canonical function-call JSON.

roles.name: Problem Analyst
roles.description: Parse the question and identify the central problem.

roles.name: Domain Reasoner
roles.description: Apply relevant domain knowledge to solve the problem.

roles.name: Evidence Checker
roles.description: Check the reasoning, assumptions, and candidate choices.

roles.name: Critical Reviewer
roles.description: Find errors and resolve competing explanations.

roles.name: Final Answer Selector
roles.description: Return the single best answer in the required format.

roles.name: Problem Interpreter
roles.description: Extract requirements, inputs, outputs, and constraints.

roles.name: Algorithm Designer
roles.description: Design an appropriate algorithm and complexity strategy.

roles.name: Implementation Engineer
roles.description: Implement a complete solution that follows the specification.

roles.name: Code Reviewer
roles.description: Check correctness, edge cases, and implementation details.

roles.name: Final Code Emitter
roles.description: Return only the final executable code in the required format.

roles.name: Direct Reasoner
roles.description: Solve the question directly and state the main answer.

roles.name: Multi-Perspective Analyst
roles.description: Analyze the question from complementary perspectives.

roles.name: Assumption Checker
roles.description: Check assumptions, evidence, and possible ambiguities.

roles.name: Critical Reviewer
roles.description: Review candidate answers and identify unsupported claims.

roles.name: Final Answer Synthesizer
roles.description: Synthesize the strongest answer and follow the output requirements.

roles.name: Entity Analyst
roles.description: Identify entities and key relations in the question.

roles.name: Evidence Collector
roles.description: Extract relevant facts from the supplied context.

roles.name: Bridge Reasoner
roles.description: Connect evidence across facts and reasoning steps.

roles.name: Answer Verifier
roles.description: Check whether the answer is supported and complete.

roles.name: Final Answer Generator
roles.description: Return the concise answer in the required format.
